strategy.name: Pullback Swing v2
strategy.description:
Strategy: Pullback Swing v2 (daily chart, decisions on Friday close, orders for Monday).
Idea: buy a short dip inside a healthy uptrend, when momentum has cooled, and only
once price starts bouncing.

ENTRY — all must be true on the decision day:
  1. Uptrend: close > SMA200, EMA50 > SMA200, EMA20 > EMA50.
  2. Pullback: close <= EMA20 x (1 + 0.02) and close > EMA50.
  3. Momentum cooled: RSI(14) < 50.
  4. Market filter: SPY above its 200-day SMA (checked separately).
  5. No earnings within the blackout window (checked by the risk step).
  Order: buy-stop at the setup day's high + 1 tick, valid 5 trading days,
  so we only buy if price bounces.

STOP AND EXITS:
  - Initial stop: entry - 2.0 x ATR(14).
  - At +1R profit: move stop to breakeven.
  - Beyond +1R: trail stop at highest high since entry - 3.0 x ATR (only moves up).
  - Weekly close below EMA50: exit next open (trend broke).
  - After 6 weeks with less than +1R: exit (stalled).

What this strategy avoids: stocks below their 200-day average (downtrends, not
pullbacks), chasing extended stocks far above EMA20, and earnings gaps.

signal.notes: Buy-stop 503.81 valid 5 trading days; stop 471.0 (2.0 x ATR 16.41).

steps.title: Final decision (code)
steps.doc:

    SKIP = a rule or reviewer said no. Reasons list every gate.
